personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (adapted for Enterprise SaaS with User's Wine-Red/Light-Blue preferences)
personality_one_liner: A highly professional, high-fidelity auto workshop SaaS blending clean white cards, subtle shadows, and a soft light-blue canvas with authoritative wine-red actions.

spacing.rule: Use 8pt grid system. Generous padding inside white cards (16pt), 12pt gap between cards, and 16-24pt horizontal screen padding. Ensure all primary CTAs have sufficient bottom safe-area spacing.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary (White) for headers and bottom tabs to maintain the clean SaaS contrast against the light blue background.
dont's: Avoid heavy blurs. The user requested maximum fidelity to a specific flat/clean wireframe style with white cards and subtle shadows.

screens.name: Login
screens.layout: Centered logo ('R' with mesh nodes, use a placeholder icon if image unavailable), Inputs for Email/Password, full-width wine-red primary button 'Entrar', secondary link 'Criar conta'.

screens.name: Dashboard (Início)
screens.purpose: Overview of workshop KPIs and immediate active tasks.

screens.layout: Scrollable layout. Top section: 2x2 grid of white KPI cards with subtle shadows (Ordens de Serviço, Em Reparação, Aguardam Cliente, Faturação). Bottom section: List of recent work orders using list row cards.

screens.purpose: CRUD list of work orders with workflow status.

screens.purpose: Detailed view of a specific work order.

screens.purpose: Client profile including contact info, vehicles, and intervention history.
screens.layout: Top banner with Client Name and contact quick-actions. Custom tabbed navigation below (Contactos, Viaturas, Histórico). Content below changes based on selected tab.

screens.purpose: Visual documentation of vehicle condition (damage, interior, etc).

screens.name: Produtos
screens.layout: Search and horizontal filter chips (Category, Stock, Fornecedor). List of white cards displaying product name, SKU, and current stock level (with low-stock indicator in red/warning). FAB for Nova Encomenda.

instructions_to_main_agent: MAXIMUM FIDELITY to user's requested style: Use #EEF3FA (soft light blue) strictly for the main background of screens.
Cards MUST be solid white (#FFFFFF) with a very subtle shadow (shadow_tier 1 or equivalent React Native elevation: 2, shadowOpacity: 0.05).
All primary action buttons MUST be full-width and use the wine-red color (#7A1E2B).
Bottom Tab Navigation must contain exactly 5 items: Início, Serviço, Clientes, Stock, Mais.

Status chips (Reparação, Orçamento, Concluído) must be pill-shaped. Use semantic colors: Warning (Amber) for Em Reparação, Success (Emerald) for Concluído, Info (Cyan/Blue) for Orçamento, and Muted (Slate) for Aguarda Cliente.
Adhere strictly to PT-PT localization: Use dd/mm/yyyy date formatting and EUR (€) for all currency displays.
Implement sticky primary CTAs (e.g., 'Concluir Ordem', 'Guardar') at the bottom of scrollable forms/details.
For the Logo, since an exact image was not provided, implement a sleek text-based or icon-based placeholder featuring a red 'R' with a mesh/network icon beside it.
Ensure every numeric or monetary value is formatted to Portuguese standards (e.g., 1.250,00 €).
